name: BBQ Chicken Loaded Potatoes

components.name: BBQ Chicken
steps: Meanwhile, coat diced chicken breast in seasonings and minced garlic, reserving barbecue sauce until chicken browns.
Heat chicken oil in a pan and sauté seasoned chicken in batches until golden and fully cooked to 74 C. Stir in BBQ sauce and coat pieces.
Divide into five equal servings with the parsley garnish. Refrigerate promptly, and crisp in an oven after reheating if desired.

components.name: Roast Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 200 C. Toss diced raw potatoes with their oil, onion and garlic powders, smoked paprika, oregano, thyme and salt.
Spread potatoes evenly on a lined baking tray and roast for roughly 25-30 minutes until cooked through and edges turn crisp.

components.name: Mozzarella & Parsley
steps: Combine roast potatoes with sauce-coated chicken, scatter mozzarella over the top, and finish under a hot oven grill just until melted.
